description: This script orchestrates the execution of the 'tsgo' tool by setting environment policies, acquiring locks, and spawning the process, ensuring safe execution and resource management within a Node.js environment.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Applies specific environment policies for the tsgo execution, modifying command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Acquires a synchronization lock to prevent concurrent heavy checks, ensuring exclusive access during the process.
